name: Guillotine Golem
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death

defensiveAbilities.name: Golem Antimagic
defensiveAbilities.description:
Harmed by acid (9d10 Untyped Damage, 3d8 Untyped Damage from areas or persistent damage); healed by electricity (area 3d8 Healing Damage HP); slowed by fire

See rules...

A golem is immune to spells and magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. These exceptions are listed in shortened form in the golem's stat block, with the full rules appearing here. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of spell can affect the golem.

  • Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of damage (this damage has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the damage listed in the parenthetical.
  • Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the slowed condition and gain HP equal to half the damage the spell would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the HP listed in the parenthetical.
  • Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be Slowed 1 for 2d6 rounds instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's slowed 1 for that round.
  • Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific spells, with the effects described in its stat block.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison
defensiveAbilities.description: Casting Cleanse Affliction on the golem deactivates its Breath Weapon for 1 minute.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerable to Rust
defensiveAbilities.description: Magical rusting effects, like a rust monster's antennae, affect the guillotine golem normally.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description: The guillotine golem emits poisonous gas in a 10ft Burst centered on the corner of one of the golem's squares. The gas persists for 1 round. Any creature in the area (or that later enters the area) is exposed to the golem's poison. The golem can't use its Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Decapitation
offensiveAbilities.description: If the guillotine golem critically hits a creature with its blade Strike, the creature must succeed at a DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be decapitated, dying instantly unless it can survive without a head.

offensiveAbilities.name: Guillotine Golem Poison
offensiveAbilities.description:
Any drained value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour.

Saving Throw DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 Poison Damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 5d6 Poison Damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 10d6 Poison Damage and Drained 3 (1 round).

offensiveAbilities.name: Inexorable March
offensiveAbilities.description: The guillotine golem Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 44 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the golem's blade Strike.
